items.en: The inauguration of the first European Linglong Tyre Center, located in Villongo, in the province of Bergamo, Italy was one of the highlights of the recent two-day Linglong European Dealer Conference in Milan. Our sister publication, Pneusnews.it was there to bring back the details.

That first dealer is Sebino Pneus, a family business belonging to the Pezzotta family, which, with a classic ribbon-cutting, inaugurated the renovated point of sale, which is also the first flagship store of Linglong Tyre and opens the way for the network of centres that the manufacturer intends to develop on the continent. Andy Zhou, CEO of Linglong Tyre, Renato Paghera, commercial director of Fintyre, partner in the project, and Gianluigi Pezzotta with his daughter Gloria, owners of the point of sale, attended the inauguration.
